title: EXEC CICS BIF DEEDIT (digits right-aligned, the negative zone, a rightmost zoned byte, LENGERR) and INQUIRE / SET TERMINAL UCTRANST with DFHVALUE CVDAs (INVREQ RESP2 43, TERMIDERR RESP2 1 / 23)

scenarios.summary: BIF DEEDIT on IBM's two examples, a trailing minus, a 1-byte field and a zoned rightmost byte; LENGTH 0 raises LENGERR (RESP)
INQUIRE TERMINAL UCTRANST returns the TYPETERM's UCTRAN as a CVDA; SET TERMINAL UCTRANST(DFHVALUE(..)) changes it; a bad CVDA is INVREQ RESP2 43; an undefined terminal is TERMIDERR
BIF DEEDIT with LENGTH 0 and no RESP: LENGERR's default action, abend AEIV
